title: How Python Audio Libraries Change Across Releases: Module Structure and Documentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.06947v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Developers who upgrade a Python audio library need to know what changed in the code they import and whether the release notes say so. Release notes and breaking changes have been mined for general software, but the module structure of audio libraries and its documentation have not been studied together. We mine 56 audio repositories used in machine learning workflows: the import graph of 49 packages at 1,395 releases, joined to 20,864 release-note and changelog entries, labeled by three open-weight language models and checked against two human coders. We find that (1) the set of a package's top-level modules is unchanged in 86.1% of consecutive release pairs, while the set of module files is unchanged in 61.4%. translated_title: Python音频库在版本发布间的变化：模块结构与文档
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.06947v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：升级Python音频库的开发者需要了解其导入的代码发生了哪些变化，以及发布说明中是否对此有所记载。针对一般软件的发布说明和破坏性变更已有挖掘研究，但音频库的模块结构及其文档尚未被共同研究。我们挖掘了56个用于机器学习工作流的音频仓库：涵盖49个软件包在1,395个发布版本中的导入依赖图，并将其与20,864条发布说明和变更日志条目相关联，这些条目由三个开源权重语言模型进行标注，并由两名人类编码员进行校验。我们发现：(1) 在86.1%的连续发布版本对中，软件包的顶级模块集合保持不变，而模块文件集合在61.4%的连续发布版本对中保持不变；(2) 主版本号递增导致顶级模块发生变化的频率是其他类型递增的5.2倍，主版本号递增与0.x次版本号递增合计占所观察到变化的48.7%；(3) 当某个发布版本移除模块时，其发布说明中仅提及了8.9%的（被移除模块，摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究首次将Python音频库的模块结构演化与发布文档进行联合挖掘分析，通过对49个软件包1,395个发布版本的导入图及20,864条语言模型标注的发布说明的大规模实证研究发现：顶级模块结构高度稳定（86.1%的连续发布中不变）、主版本号递增引发结构变化的频率是其他递增的5.2倍，但发布说明仅覆盖约8.9%的模块移除事件。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first joint mining study of module structure evolution and release documentation in Python audio libraries, analyzing import graphs across 1,395 releases of 49 packages alongside 20,864 release-note entries labeled by open-weight LLMs, revealing that top-level module structure is highly stable (unchanged in 86.1% of consecutive releases), major version increments change the top level 5.2 times more often than other increments, yet release notes document only 8.9% of module removals.
